title.zh: Claude补上Google办公短板，Docs、Sheets、Slides终于能直接改
title.en: Claude补上Google办公短板，Docs、Sheets、Slides终于能直接改

current_state.zh: Anthropic opened a public beta of Claude for Google Workspace that lets paid-tier users read and directly edit Google Docs, Sheets and Slides from a sidebar, plus new connectors for creating and editing Google files from Claude chat.
current_state.en: Anthropic opened a public beta of Claude for Google Workspace that lets paid-tier users read and directly edit Google Docs, Sheets and Slides from a sidebar, plus new connectors for creating and editing Google files from Claude chat.
